fato_historico: 1789: The first U.S. federal government agency, the Department of Foreign Affairs, is established (it will be later renamed Department of State).
energia_do_dia: Today brings a refreshing surge of diplomatic energy, much like the historic birth of a formal state department. It is a good time to consider how you organize your own internal affairs. You may find that setting clear boundaries allows your authentic power to shine brighter while you build lasting connections with those who truly value your depth.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the grace of your own transformation.
significado_numero: Represents the spark of new beginnings and building a stable legacy.
conselho: Communicate your intentions clearly to foster harmony in your most important relationships.
